title: Compass Bar
description: Displays a compass with cardinal directions (N, S, E, W) at the top of the screen.
body:
# Compass Bar
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/884a1709e80b505a6b5faa43f5e1df57a73b6d51_0.webp)

**Compass Bar** is a simple client-side mod for Minecraft that adds a compass displaying **degree angles** and **cardinal directions** at the top of the screen (similar to Rust, PUBG, etc.).

### Warning (please read)
> If the version you want to download the mod for is missing, please open an [issue](https://github.com/11ato/CompassBar/issues).

## Requirements
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
